structure.unit: Form and Effect of Deeds and Covenants; Liens
Form and Effect of Deeds of Trust; Sales Thereunder; Assignments; Releases

law.catch_line: Release to person dead inures to successors
law.text: A release of a deed of trust or a conveyance of the property embraced in such deed of trust may in all cases be made to the original grantor, whether living or dead, and any release or reconveyance so made shall inure both in law and in equity to the successors in title of such grantor.
